paras: Emoia klossi, also known commonly as Kloss's emo skink, Kloss' emo skink, and Kloss' skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is native to Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.
The specific name, klossi, is in honor of English zoologist Cecil Boden Kloss.
The preferred natural habitat of E. klossi is forest, at altitudes of 800–1,200 m (2,600–3,900 ft).
